# Cover

<p class="gls-text-lead">Expand images, videos or iframes to cover their entire container and place your own content on top.</p>

## Usage

To have an image cover its parent element, add the `.gls-cover-container` class to the parent and the `gls-cover` attribute to the image.

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container">
    <img src="" alt="" gls-cover />
</div>
```

**Note** To position content on top of the covering element, use the [Position component](https://getuikit.com/docs/position). To adapt your content for better visibility, add the `.gls-light` or `.gls-dark` class from the [Inverse component](https://getuikit.com/docs/inverse).

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-cover-container gls-height-medium">
    <img src="images/dark.jpg" alt="" gls-cover>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container gls-height-medium">
    <img src="images/dark.jpg" alt="" gls-cover />
</div>
```

---

## Video

To create a video that covers its parent container, add the `gls-cover` attribute to a video. Wrap a container element around the video and add the `.gls-cover-container` class to clip the content.

The Cover component inherits all properties from the [Video component](https://getuikit.com/docs/video) which means videos are muted and play automatically. The video will pause whenever it's not visible and resume once it becomes visible again.

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container">
    <video gls-cover></video>
</div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-cover-container gls-height-medium">
    <video src="https://yootheme.com/media/videos/yootheme-pro.mp4" autoplay loop muted playsinline gls-cover></video>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container gls-height-medium">
    <video
        src="https://yootheme.com/media/videos/yootheme-pro.mp4"
        autoplay
        loop
        muted
        playsinline
        gls-cover
    ></video>
</div>
```

---

## Iframe

To apply the Cover component to an iframe, you need to add the `gls-cover` attribute to the iframe. Now add the `.gls-cover-container` class to a container element around the iframe to clip the content.

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container">
    <iframe src="" gls-cover></iframe>
</div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-cover-container gls-height-medium">
    <iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/c2pz2mlSfXA?playsinline=1&amp;rel=0&amp;controls=0&amp;loop=1" width="1920" height="1080" allowfullscreen gls-cover></iframe>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container gls-height-medium">
    <iframe
        src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/c2pz2mlSfXA?playsinline=1&amp;rel=0&amp;controls=0&amp;loop=1"
        width="1920"
        height="1080"
        allowfullscreen
        gls-cover
    ></iframe>
</div>
```

---

## Responsive height

To add responsive behavior to your cover image, you need to create an invisible `<canvas>` element and assign `width` and `height` values to it, according to the aspect ratio you want the covered area to have. That way it will adapt the responsive behavior of the image.

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container">
    <canvas width="" height=""></canvas>
    <img src="" alt="" gls-cover />
</div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-cover-container">
    <canvas width="400" height="200"></canvas>
    <img src="images/dark.jpg" alt="" gls-cover>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container">
    <canvas width="400" height="200"></canvas>
    <img src="images/dark.jpg" alt="" gls-cover />
</div>
```

---

## Viewport height

Adding the `gls-height-viewport` attribute from the [Height component](https://getuikit.com/docs/height#viewport-height) will stretch the height of the parent element to fill the whole viewport.

```html
<div class="gls-cover-container" gls-height-viewport>
    <img src="" alt="" gls-cover />
</div>
```

---

## Component options

Any of these options can be applied to the component attribute. Separate multiple options with a semicolon. [Learn more](https://getuikit.com/docs/javascript#component-configuration)

| Option     | Value   | Default | Description                           |
| ---------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `automute` | Boolean | true    | Tries to automute the iframe's video. |
| `width`    | Number  |         | The element's width.                  |
| `height`   | Number  |         | The element's height.                 |

---

## JavaScript

Learn more about [JavaScript components](https://getuikit.com/docs/javascript#programmatic-use).

### Initialization

```js
UIkit.cover(element, options);
```
